quests.instruction: In autumn, a maple tree's leaves change from green to a bright, fiery color. What color do many maple leaves turn?
quests.question: Red
quests.hint: Think about a stop sign at the corner.
quests.explanation: Yes! Many maple leaves turn this bright color in autumn, before they fall.
quests.funFact: Leaves change color in autumn because they stop making the green pigment that helps them catch sunlight!

quests.instruction: In autumn, an oak tree's leaves often turn from green to a warm, earthy color. What color do many oak leaves turn?
quests.question: Brown
quests.hint: Think about the color of a well-worn saddle.
quests.explanation: Yes! Oak leaves often turn this warm, earthy color in autumn.
quests.funFact: Some oak trees hold onto their brown leaves all winter, even after other trees are bare!

quests.instruction: As winter arrives, evergreen trees like pine and fir keep their color all season. What color stays the same through winter?
quests.question: Green
quests.hint: Think of fresh grass or a healthy leaf.
quests.explanation: Yes! Evergreen trees keep this color all year, even in the coldest winter.
quests.funFact: That's exactly why they're called 'evergreens' — they stay green all year round!

quests.instruction: In spring, cherry trees burst into bloom with soft, delicate blossoms. What color are classic cherry blossoms?
quests.question: Light Pink
quests.hint: Think of a baby blanket or cotton candy.
quests.explanation: Yes! Classic cherry blossoms bloom in this soft, gentle color.
quests.funFact: In Japan, people celebrate spring every year with parties held under blooming cherry trees!

quests.instruction: In summer, a clear ocean under bright sun often looks a vivid, tropical color. What color does it often look?
quests.question: Teal
quests.hint: Think of a color right between blue and green.
quests.explanation: Yes! Shallow, sunny ocean water often looks this bright blue-green color.
quests.funFact: Deeper ocean water looks much darker blue because sunlight can't reach as far down!

quests.instruction: At sunset, the sky often fills with warm colors as the sun goes down. Which warm color often appears right along the horizon?
quests.question: Orange
quests.hint: Think about a construction worker's safety vest.
quests.explanation: Yes! The sky near the horizon often glows this warm color at sunset.
quests.funFact: Sunsets look this color because sunlight has to travel through more air, scattering away the blues!

quests.instruction: During a heavy snowfall, an entire winter landscape can turn one bright color. What color covers everything in fresh snow?
quests.question: White
quests.hint: Think of a cloud or a glass of milk.
quests.explanation: Yes! Fresh snowfall covers the ground in this bright, clean color.
quests.funFact: A single snowstorm can drop enough snowflakes to cover a whole town in white!

quests.instruction: In a rainforest, the thick canopy of leaves overhead creates a deep, shaded color below. What color is a rainforest canopy mostly?
quests.question: Dark Green
quests.hint: Think of a pine tree or deep forest moss.
quests.explanation: Yes! A thick rainforest canopy is usually this deep, rich green.
quests.funFact: Rainforests are home to more than half of all the plant and animal species on Earth!

quests.instruction: As a banana ripens on the counter, its peel slowly changes color. What color does an unripe banana start out?
quests.question: Green
quests.hint: Think about the color of grass before it's mowed.
quests.explanation: Yes! Bananas start out this color and slowly turn yellow as they ripen.
quests.funFact: Bananas keep ripening even after they're picked, thanks to a natural gas they release!

quests.instruction: A ripe tomato on the vine starts out one color and ends up another. What color is an unripe tomato?
quests.question: Green
quests.hint: Think about the color of a fresh cucumber.
quests.explanation: Yes! Tomatoes start out this color and slowly turn red as they ripen in the sun.
quests.funFact: The chemical that turns tomatoes red is the same one that colors carrots orange!

quests.instruction: In the Arctic, some animals grow white fur only in winter to blend into the snow. What color is an Arctic fox's fur in summer instead?
quests.question: Brown
quests.hint: Think about the color of a walnut shell.
quests.explanation: Yes! An Arctic fox grows brown or gray fur in summer, then turns white for winter.
quests.funFact: This clever color change helps the fox hide from predators all year round!

quests.instruction: At high noon, with the sun directly overhead, the clear sky usually looks its brightest, boldest color. What color is that?
quests.question: Blue
quests.hint: Think of the ocean or a swimming pool.
quests.explanation: Yes! At midday, a clear sky often looks its brightest, boldest shade of this color.
quests.funFact: The sky looks less blue near sunset because sunlight travels through more air to reach your eyes!

quests.instruction: A field of sunflowers all turns to face one direction during the day. What color fills the field when they bloom?
quests.question: Yellow
quests.hint: Think about a rubber duck in the bathtub.
quests.explanation: Yes! A blooming sunflower field turns this bright, cheerful color.
quests.funFact: Young sunflowers actually turn to follow the sun across the sky each day!

quests.instruction: In a garden in early spring, tulip bulbs push up from the soil before blooming. What color are most tulip leaves and stems?
quests.question: Green
quests.hint: Think about the color of a lime or fresh spinach.
quests.explanation: Yes! Tulip leaves and stems are this fresh color before the colorful flowers open.
quests.funFact: Tulip bulbs need a cold winter before they're able to bloom in spring!

quests.instruction: As grapes ripen on the vine in late summer, their skins deepen in color. What color do ripe purple grapes start as?
quests.question: Green
quests.hint: Think about the color of a healthy garden hedge.
quests.explanation: Yes! Grapes start out this color and slowly deepen to purple as they ripen.
quests.funFact: Farmers can tell grapes are ready to pick by tasting them, not just by their color!

quests.instruction: Fill in the blank: The ___ sun set slowly behind the mountains.
quests.question: Orange
quests.hint: Think of the warm color of a sunset.
quests.explanation: Yes! 'Orange' fits perfectly to describe a glowing sunset.
quests.funFact: Describing colors like this helps make stories feel more vivid and real!

quests.instruction: Fill in the blank: She wore a ___ scarf that matched the winter sky.
quests.question: Gray
quests.hint: Think of the color of storm clouds.
quests.explanation: Yes! 'Gray' fits well to describe a winter sky.
quests.funFact: Writers often use color words like this to help readers picture a scene clearly!

quests.instruction: Fill in the blank: The ___ leaves crunched under our feet in the park.
quests.question: Brown
quests.hint: Think of the color of fallen autumn leaves.
quests.explanation: Yes! 'Brown' fits well to describe crunchy, fallen leaves.
quests.funFact: Fallen leaves crunch because they lose their water and become dry and crisp!

quests.instruction: Fill in the blank: The chef added a ___ pepper to make the soup extra spicy.
quests.question: Red
quests.hint: Think of the color of a ripe tomato.
quests.explanation: Yes! 'Red' fits well, since many spicy peppers are this bold color.
quests.funFact: The spiciness in peppers comes from a chemical called capsaicin!

quests.instruction: Fill in the blank: The garden was full of ___ roses in full bloom.
quests.question: Red
quests.hint: Think of the classic color of a rose given as a gift.
quests.explanation: Yes! 'Red' fits well, since it's the most classic rose color.
quests.funFact: Roses actually grow naturally in many colors, not just this one!

quests.instruction: Fill in the blank: The puppy had soft, ___ fur just like a teddy bear.
quests.question: Brown
quests.hint: Think of the color of chocolate or a tree trunk.
quests.explanation: Yes! 'Brown' fits well to describe cozy, teddy-bear-like fur.
quests.funFact: Many popular dog breeds come in this warm, earthy fur color!

quests.instruction: Fill in the blank: The old barn had faded to a soft ___ color after years in the sun.
quests.question: Red
quests.hint: Think of the classic color used to paint barns.
quests.explanation: Yes! 'Red' fits well, since barns are traditionally painted this color.
quests.funFact: Long ago, farmers mixed red iron-rich dirt into paint because it was cheap and easy to find!

quests.instruction: Fill in the blank: The knight's armor gleamed a shiny ___ in the sunlight.
quests.question: Silver
quests.hint: Think of the color of a spoon or a coin.
quests.explanation: Yes! 'Silver' fits well to describe shiny, polished metal armor.
quests.funFact: Real armor was often polished for hours to make it shine and reflect sunlight!

quests.instruction: Fill in the blank: The tropical bird had feathers of bright ___ and yellow.
quests.question: Teal
quests.hint: Think of the color right between blue and green.
quests.explanation: Yes! 'Teal' fits well to describe a vivid tropical bird.
quests.funFact: Tropical birds often have the boldest, brightest feathers of any birds in the world!

quests.instruction: Fill in the blank: Grandma's kitchen curtains were a cheerful ___ with tiny flowers.
quests.question: Yellow
quests.hint: Think of the color of the sun or a ripe lemon.
quests.explanation: Yes! 'Yellow' fits well to describe a warm, cheerful kitchen.
quests.funFact: This bright color is often used in kitchens because it can make a room feel warm and happy!

quests.instruction: Fill in the blank: The campfire glowed a warm ___ as the logs crackled.
quests.question: Orange
quests.hint: Think of the color of a pumpkin or warm flames.
quests.explanation: Yes! 'Orange' fits well to describe the warm glow of a campfire.
quests.funFact: Fire glows this color because of how hot the burning gases are!

quests.instruction: Fill in the blank: The little girl's balloon floated away, a bright spot of ___ against the sky.
quests.question: Red
quests.hint: Think of the color of an apple or a fire truck.
quests.explanation: Yes! 'Red' fits well, standing out brightly against a blue sky.
quests.funFact: Bright colors like this one stand out most clearly against a plain blue sky!

quests.instruction: Fill in the blank: The chef sprinkled fresh ___ herbs over the finished dish.
quests.question: Green
quests.hint: Think of the color of basil or fresh mint.
quests.explanation: Yes! 'Green' fits well to describe fresh herbs like parsley or basil.
quests.funFact: Chefs often add fresh herbs right at the end of cooking to keep their bright color and flavor!

quests.instruction: Fill in the blank: The old photograph had faded to a soft ___ over the years.
quests.question: Beige
quests.hint: Think of the color of plain oatmeal or dry sand.
quests.explanation: Yes! 'Beige' fits well to describe an old, faded photograph.
quests.funFact: Old photographs fade over time because light slowly breaks down their colors!

quests.instruction: Fill in the blank: The peacock spread its tail to show off feathers of ___ and gold.
quests.question: Teal
quests.hint: Think about the color of a tropical lagoon.
quests.explanation: Yes! 'Teal' fits well to describe a peacock's shimmering feathers.
quests.funFact: A peacock's tail feathers can be longer than the rest of its whole body!
